name: α-PHP
addictionPotential: highly addictive with a high potential for abuse
summary: A powerful stimulant cathinone, analogue of alpha-PVP and related to pyrovalerone. Said to have high addictive potential, compulsive redosing and relatively short duration. Often insufflated or vapourised.

tolerance.buildUp: develops with prolonged and repeated use

pharmacology.text: The mechanism of action of α-PHP is unknown. Aside from a substantially shorter duration, it is believed to act similarly to the designer drug pentedrone and α-PVP, which both act as a potent norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitors (NDRI), although no substantial research on the pharmacology of this compound has yet been conducted.

uses.text: α-Pyrrolidinohexiophenone (α-PHP, A-PHP, Aphp, alpha-PHP, α-Pyrrolidinohexanophenone, PV-7) is a synthetic stimulant drug of the cathinone class developed in the 1960s which has been reported as a novel designer drug.
uses.routes: Oral, intranasal, vaporization, intravenous, rectal, sublingual, subcutaneous

summaryZh: α-吡咯烷基苯己酮（英語：α-Pyrrolidinohexiophenone，縮寫：α-PHP，或稱為：1-苯基-2-(N-吡咯烷基)-1-己酮、PV-7）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C16H23NO，屬於卡西酮衍生物，1960年代研發，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include a racing heart, raised blood pressure, chest pain, sweating, sleeplessness lasting days, anxiety, paranoia and psychosis. Compulsive redosing is common and it carries a high risk of dependence. Overheating and heart problems have been reported with drugs of this family.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括心跳急促、血壓升高、胸痛、出汗、連續數日失眠、焦慮、妄想與精神病。強迫性連續補用很常見，成癮風險高。同家族藥物曾有體溫過高與心臟問題的報告。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括心跳急促、血压升高、胸痛、出汗、连续数日失眠、焦虑、妄想与精神病。强迫性连续补用很常见，成瘾风险高。同家族药物曾有体温过高与心脏问题的报告。

fact.en: Its full name, alpha-pyrrolidinohexiophenone, spells out its structure: a hexanophenone with a pyrrolidine ring. It is one carbon longer than alpha-PVP, the drug sold as flakka.
fact.zh: 它的全名 alpha-pyrrolidinohexiophenone 說明了結構：帶有吡咯烷環的己醯苯。它比俗稱 flakka 的 alpha-PVP 多一個碳。
fact.zhHans: 它的全名 alpha-pyrrolidinohexiophenone 说明了结构：带有吡咯烷环的己酰苯。它比俗称 flakka 的 alpha-PVP 多一个碳。
